title: Wing knob
about: A wing knob for an M5 screw, turned by thumb and finger like a wing nut: a round hub, and one long wing drawn right across it and joined on. The wing is a little lower than the hub, so the hub stands up in the middle.
picture_alt: A round hub with a flat wing through it, and a hole in the middle

sketch.constrain sketch=WingSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=4 name=Thickness
